APP_DESCRIPTION: Wardrobe organizer: garments, outfits, and a calendar.

profile.STYLE_HINT: Your styles, palette and budget: what your agent goes by.
profile.SIGN_OUT_HINT: Signs out this device only. Changing your password signs out every device.
profile.EXPORT_HINT: Download every garment in your wardrobe with all its details: a CSV for spreadsheets, or JSON with links to the photos, for a backup.

changeEntry.TITLE: Change outfit
changeEntry.WORN_NOTE: {name} is marked worn, so it stays as the record of that day. Add another outfit instead.
changeEntry.REFUSED_WORN: This outfit is marked worn, so it stays as the record of that day. Add another outfit to the day instead.
changeEntry.REFUSED_ON_DAY: That outfit is already planned on this day ({occasion}).

validation.IS_EMAIL: Please provide a valid email address
validation.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH: Password must be at least 8 characters long
validation.PASSWORD_MUST_CONTAIN: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number
validation.UNKNOWN_COLOR: Not a color this wardrobe knows: {color}
validation.INVALID_DATE: Enter a real date, or leave it empty
validation.SOURCE_URL_INVALID: Enter a web address starting with https:// or http://, or leave it empty
validation.PRICE_INVALID: Enter a price such as 49.90, or leave it empty
validation.FABRIC_WEIGHT_NUMBER: Enter the weight as a number, or leave it empty
validation.CAPSULE_NAME_TAKEN: You already have a capsule with this name

validation.REPAIR_DAY_REQUIRED: Enter the day it was done

agentAccess.TITLE: Agent Access
agentAccess.INTRO: A personal access token lets your own Claude, or another MCP client, work on your wardrobe as you: search it, add from links, build outfits and plan days. It reaches the app over the tailnet only. Changing your password revokes every token.
agentAccess.NAME: Name
agentAccess.PASSWORD_WHY: A token keeps working after you sign out, so creating one asks for your password.
agentAccess.SHOWN_ONCE: Copy this token now: it is not shown again.
agentAccess.REVOKE_CONFIRM: Revoke {name}? Anything using it stops working at once.
agentAccess.TOO_MANY: You have {max} tokens. Revoke one first.

SHARE_WARDROBE_DESC: Invite someone to view or manage your wardrobe.
INVITE_VIEW_DESC: They can view all your garments but cannot edit, add, or delete anything.
INVITE_MANAGE_DESC: They can view, add, and edit garments in your wardrobe, but cannot delete.
INVITE_LOGIN_REQUIRED: You need to log in or create an account to accept this invitation.
INVITE_NOT_FOUND: Invite not found or has expired.
SHARE_ERROR_NOT_FOUND: Invite not found or has already been accepted.
SHARE_ERROR_OWN_INVITE: You cannot accept your own invite.
SHARE_ERROR_WRONG_RECIPIENT: This invite was sent to a different email address.
SHARE_ERROR_ALREADY_SHARED: You already have access to this wardrobe.
ABOUT_INTRO: {appName} is a private fork of Libre Closet, the open-source wardrobe organizer by Lazztech LLC, licensed under the AGPL-3.0.
ABOUT_OPEN_SOURCE_DESC: {appName} keeps the upstream AGPL-3.0 license. The source code for this fork and for the original project is available on GitHub.
ABOUT_TECH_DESC: Built with NestJS, HTMX, PostgreSQL, Docker, and ONNX runtime for client-side AI background removal. The progressive web app works offline on desktop and mobile.
LOGIN_OG_DESC: Sign in to {appName} to manage your wardrobe, build outfits, and plan looks.
REGISTER_OG_DESC: Create your {appName} account to catalog garments, build outfits, and plan looks.
PUSH_STATE_ON: Notifications are on for this device.
PUSH_STATE_OFF: Notifications are off on this device.
PUSH_STATE_BLOCKED: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser or system settings, then reload this page.
PUSH_STATE_INSTALL: On iPhone and iPad, notifications need the installed app: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and enable them from the app.
PUSH_STATE_ERROR: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
PUSH_TEST_BODY: This is the test you sent from your profile.
PUSH_TEST_SENT: Test sent to {count} of your devices.
PUSH_TEST_NO_DEVICES: No device has notifications on. Enable them on this device first.
PUSH_TEST_FAILED: The test could not be delivered to {count} of your devices. Try again later.
PUSH_TEST_REMOVED: Devices that no longer accept notifications were removed: {count}.
BULK_HINT: Pick a property, then its value. Garments it does not apply to are skipped.
BULK_MATERIALS_ADD: Adds the material to each garment’s materials.
BULK_RESULT_SKIPPED: Set on {updated} garments · {skipped} skipped (does not apply)

add.TITLE: Add
add.PHOTO_CUTOUT_HINT: The background is removed once you save.
add.PHOTO_GONE: That photo is no longer available. Save without it and add a photo on the garment page, or add it again.

drafts.QUEUE_HINT: Save each one to move on to the next. Photos wait here for a week.
drafts.LEFT_OUT: These could not be read, so they were left out: {names}
drafts.NONE_READ: None of these photos could be read. Choose JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photos.
drafts.FULL: You have {held} photos waiting to be added, and at most {max} can wait at once. Add or discard some of them, then choose again.
drafts.DONE: {count} garments added and selected. Set… tags them all at once.
drafts.DONE_ONE: 1 garment added and selected. Set… tags it.

CONFIRM_DELETE_CAPSULE: Delete this capsule? Its garments stay in the wardrobe.
NO_CAPSULES: No capsules yet. A capsule is a set of garments for one purpose: the office, weekends, a trip.
NO_CAPSULES_SHARED: No capsules in this wardrobe yet.
CAPSULE_EMPTY: No garments in this capsule yet.
TAG_ALL_DONE: Every garment has its details. Nice.
TAG_PASS_DONE: End of this pass. {count} garments you skipped still need details.
TAG_PASS_DONE_ONE: End of this pass. 1 garment you skipped still needs details.
PRODUCT_LINK_PLACEHOLDER: https://… the page you bought it from

linkImport.TITLE: Add from a link
linkImport.INTRO: Paste the link to the product page, or to a photo of it. The form opens filled in with what the page says; nothing is saved until you save the form.
linkImport.FETCH_HINT: Fetching can take a few seconds.
linkImport.NO_LINK: Paste a link that starts with http:// or https://.
linkImport.INVALID_URL: That doesn't look like a link. Paste the whole address.
linkImport.UNSUPPORTED_SCHEME: Only web links (http or https) can be added.
linkImport.CREDENTIALS_IN_URL: Links with a user name or password in them can't be fetched.
linkImport.PORT_NOT_ALLOWED: Links to an unusual port can't be fetched.
linkImport.UNRESOLVABLE: That site couldn't be found. Check the link.
linkImport.BLOCKED_ADDRESS: That link leads to a private network, so it can't be fetched.
linkImport.TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS: That link redirected too many times.
linkImport.HTTP_STATUS: The site refused the request. Some shops block this; try a link to the photo instead.
linkImport.UNEXPECTED_CONTENT_TYPE: That link isn't a web page or a photo.
linkImport.TOO_LARGE: That page or photo is too large to add.
linkImport.TIMEOUT: The site took too long to answer.
linkImport.RATE_LIMITED: Too many photos fetched in the last minute. Try again in a minute.
linkImport.FOUND_DETAILS: Filled in from the page. Check everything before saving.
linkImport.NOTHING_FOUND: Nothing could be read from that page. The link is kept below; fill in the rest, or add from a link to the photo instead.
linkImport.NO_PHOTO: No photo could be fetched from the page. Add one after saving.
linkImport.PHOTO_ONLY: Photo added from the link. Fill in the details.
linkImport.PRICE_CURRENCY: The page's price is in {currency}; enter what you paid in dollars.
linkImport.PHOTO_GONE: The photo from the link is no longer available. Save without it and add a photo on the garment page, or add from the link again.

QUANTITY_HINT: Three of the same white tee are one garment with 3 copies.
CONDITION_NOTE_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. hole in the left elbow

wear.AWAY_NOTE_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Dana has it, or the cobbler on Fulton St

garment.PHOTO_HINT: The background is removed for you.

CONFIRM_RESTORE: Restore this garment? It will show in your wardrobe again.

wishlist.TITLE: Wishlist
wishlist.ADD_FROM_LINK_TITLE: Add to wishlist from a link
wishlist.EMPTY: Nothing on the wishlist yet. Add what you are thinking of buying, from a link or by hand.
wishlist.ON_WISHLIST_TO_REPLACE: On the wishlist to replace it:
wishlist.BOUGHT_INTRO: It moves to your closet with its photo, details and link. Correct the day and the price if they differ.
wishlist.NOT_ON_WISHLIST: This is no longer on the wishlist.
wishlist.SUGGESTION_NOT_DELETED: This is one of Muse’s suggestions: it is kept as feedback for Muse, never deleted.
wishlist.CONFIRM_REMOVE: Remove this from the wishlist? It will be deleted.

muse.NOT_FOR_ME_HINT: Tap a reason. Muse learns from it.
muse.NO_OPTIONS_LEFT: No options left for this need.
muse.BEST_LABEL: Its best outfits with your closet
muse.CONFIRM_RETURNED: Returned it? It moves to the archive, and the need is open again.
muse.BOUGHT_FOR: Bought for “{need}”: Muse sees what you chose instead of its picks.
muse.TODAY_CARD: {agent} has {count} needs for you to decide on
muse.TODAY_CARD_ONE: {agent} has 1 need for you to decide on
muse.STALE: This changed since the page was drawn. Reload to see where it stands.

toast.choose: Chosen: it’s in Ready to buy
toast.dismiss: Set aside. Muse learns from it.
toast.returned: Archived as returned. The need is open again.
toast.boughtFor: In your closet now. Muse sees the need is met.

weather.SET_LOCATION: Add your city for the weather
weather.NO_HOME: No home city yet. Search for yours to see its weather.
weather.SEARCH_FAILED: The search did not work just now. Try again in a moment.
weather.USING_HERE: Using your location from {since}, until {until}; then your home city again.
weather.HERE_DENIED: Location is blocked for this app. Allow it in your settings, or search your city.
weather.HERE_FAILED: Your location could not be found. Try again, or search your city.
weather.HERE_NOT_SAVED: Your location could not be saved. Try again, or search your city.
weather.OFFSET_NONE: Outfits are matched to the forecast as it is.
weather.OFFSET_WARM: You run warm: outfits are matched as if it were {degrees} warmer.
weather.OFFSET_COLD: You run cold: outfits are matched as if it were {degrees} colder.

style.TITLE: Style profile
style.INTRO: How you dress and what your weeks hold. Your agent reads it before it suggests what to buy or wear.
style.BUDGET_HINT: Budget under $50 · Mid $50–150 · Premium $150–400 · Luxury above
style.WEEK_NONE: Not set yet: say what each day holds, and Plan my week fills it.
style.NOTES_PLACEHOLDER: Anything else: dress codes, a climate, what you never wear

gallery.TITLE: Outfit ideas
gallery.STRIP_LABEL: Outfit ideas, more to either side
gallery.OFFLINE: Offline: these are the ideas from your last visit. Saving or planning one needs a connection.
gallery.EMPTY: No ideas yet. Ideas need a clean top and bottom (or a dress) in the closet, and shoes if you have any.
gallery.EMPTY_CAPSULE: No ideas from this capsule. It needs a clean top and bottom (or a dress), and shoes if you have any.
gallery.CLASHES_PROMPT: Clashes? Tap the two that never go together:

problem.too-casual: A bit casual for the occasion
problem.too-dressy: A bit dressy for the occasion

gallery.ALREADY_SAVED: Already saved: this outfit was picked before.
gallery.SAVED_MUSE: Saved Muse’s outfit: it’s yours now

outfits.PICK_PROMPT: Tap an outfit to plan it.
outfits.OFFLINE_PICK: Offline: planning an outfit needs a connection.
outfits.GONE_WISHLIST: {name} is on your wishlist, not bought yet
outfits.GONE_WISHLIST_HELD: {name} is not bought yet, and this outfit is planned or on a trip
outfits.GONE_SET_ASIDE: {name} was set aside, so it is not on offer to style
outfits.GONE_ONE: a garment you chose is no longer in your wardrobe
outfits.GONE_MANY: {count} garments you chose are no longer in your wardrobe
outfits.INCOMPLETE: Buy {pieces} first: an outfit with pieces not bought yet can’t be planned or packed.

muse.TITLE: From {agent}
muse.NEEDS_REPLACEMENT: Needs a replacement: {name} was set aside
muse.NOT_YOURS_YET: Save it first: Muse’s outfits are planned or packed once they’re yours.
muse.ALREADY_YOURS: This outfit is yours now: it was saved since this page was drawn.
muse.DELETE_REFUSED: Not for me sets one of Muse’s outfits aside: Muse learns from it, and you can undo it.

insights.TITLE: Insights
insights.INTRO: How your closet is actually used, from the days you marked worn.
insights.EMPTY: Nothing to measure yet. Add garments, then mark what you wear on the calendar or with “Wore today”.
insights.NO_WEARS: Nothing marked worn in the last year yet. Mark outfits worn on the calendar, or a garment with “Wore today”, and these figures fill in.
insights.UNWORN_NONE: Everything you have owned that long was worn in the last {days} days.
insights.LEAST_WORN_NOTE: Among garments owned for {days} days or more.
insights.COST_INTRO: What a garment cost (its price, times its copies, plus its repairs) over the days it was worn.
insights.NO_PRICES: Add what you paid to a garment (Edit › More details) to see its cost per wear.
insights.PAIRS_INTRO: Pairs worn on the same days in the last year.
insights.PAIRS_NONE: No two garments worn on the same day twice yet.
insights.COLOUR_SHARE: {closet}% of the closet, {worn}% of what you wear
insights.UNCOLOURED: {count} without a colour: {closet}% of the closet, {worn}% of what you wear

recap.TITLE: Year in review
recap.SAVE_IMAGE_NOTE: A picture of your year, to keep or send. The app shares nothing itself.
recap.SAVE_IMAGE_FAILED: The image could not be drawn. Tap Save image to try again.
recap.BEST_VALUE_NOTE: Among what was worn this year, counting every wear and repair up to {date}.
recap.EMPTY_FEW: Only {count} wears were marked in {year}. A recap needs {min}.
recap.EMPTY_OWNER: Mark what you wear on the calendar or with “Wore today”, and your year fills in.

lookalikes.TITLE: Looks like one you already have
lookalikes.HINT: Same kind and colours, no other brand. A copy counts one more of it instead of saving a new garment; nothing on this form is kept.
lookalikes.TOO_MANY: That would be more than {max} copies, the most a garment holds
lookalikes.NOT_IN_CLOSET: Only a garment in the closet has copies to add

goesWith.TITLE: Goes with my closet
goesWith.COUNT_NONE: Nothing in your closet goes with it yet
goesWith.JUDGED: Judged on colour, pattern, formality and your clashes, not the weather: you would wear it in more than one season.
goesWith.BEST_LABEL: The best outfits with it, more to either side
goesWith.DISPLAY_ONLY: Ideas only: once you have bought it, you can save and plan them.
goesWith.DUPLICATES_HINT: Same kind and colour. Do you need another?

styling.TITLE: Styling
styling.NO_IDEA: Nothing clean goes with the locked rows. Unlock one and shuffle again.
styling.SHARED: You're styling {name}'s wardrobe. Outfits are private, so nothing styled here can be saved.
styling.SHARED_NO_SAVE: Browsing only: outfits styled here are not saved.
styling.OFFLINE: Offline: choosing still works, but shuffling and saving need a connection.
styling.EMPTY: Add some garments to your wardrobe to start styling outfits.
styling.EMPTY_CAPSULE: No garments in this capsule yet.
styling.REFUSED_HINT: Those rows are back to None: choose again, then save.
styling.INCOMPLETE_HINT: Your rows are as you left them: save without a day, or buy what’s named first.

today.TITLE: Today
today.OFFLINE: Offline: this is Today from your last visit. Wearing an outfit needs a connection.
today.STRIP_LABEL: Ideas for today, more to either side

push.MORNING_NOTHING: Nothing planned yet. Open Today for ideas.
push.EVENING_PLANNED: Planned: {outfits}. Tap to mark what you wore.

reminders.HEADING: Send to this device
reminders.EVENING_HINT: Not sent once something is marked worn that day.
reminders.SAVED_TIMES: Saved. A time already past today starts tomorrow.
reminders.NOT_REGISTERED: Turn notifications on for this device to choose reminders.
reminders.MUSE_HINT: One notification per round of suggestions, opening what it brought.

selfie.REMOVE_CONFIRM: Remove this selfie? The outfit stays marked worn.
selfie.DETACHED: Worn (outfit no longer on the day)

weekPlan.NOTHING_PLANNED: Nothing new to plan: every slot of your week has an outfit or nothing clean fits it.
weekPlan.UNDO_CONFIRM: Remove the outfits this plan added? Anything you edited or wore stays.
weekPlan.AUTO_TITLE: Planned by Plan my week. It may be swapped for the weather until you edit or wear it.

template.HEADING: Your week
template.HINT: What each day holds. Plan my week, on the calendar, fills it with outfits for the next 7 days.

push.TITLE: Your week changed
push.SWING: {slot} swings warm to cold: swapped in {garments}
push.LENT: {garment} is lent out: swapped in {garments} on {slot}
push.REPAIR: {garment} is at repair: swapped in {garments} on {slot}
push.WISHLIST: {garment} is not in your closet: swapped in {garments} on {slot}
push.DIRTY: {garment} needs a wash: swapped in {garments} on {slot}
push.DELETED: A garment of {slot}'s outfit was deleted: swapped in {garments}

why.DELETED: a garment of it was deleted

trips.TITLE: Trips
trips.EMPTY: No trips yet. Plan the outfits for a trip and get its packing list.
trips.ENDS_BEFORE_START: The last day comes before the first
trips.TOO_LONG: A trip is at most {days} days
trips.CONFIRM_DELETE: Delete this trip? Its outfits stay saved.
trips.OFFLINE: Offline: this is the trip from your last visit. Packing and changes need a connection.
trips.FIND_PLACE: Find the destination for its forecast
trips.WEATHER_NO_PLACE: Find the destination on the map to see its forecast.
trips.WEATHER_UNAVAILABLE: No forecast for the destination right now.
trips.FORECAST_FROM: The forecast for {day} arrives on {from}: forecasts reach 16 days ahead.
trips.FORECAST_LATER: From {day}: the forecast arrives day by day from {from}.
trips.TYPICAL_NOTE: Meanwhile, the typical weather for those dates (the average of the last {years} years), not a forecast:
trips.DAY_EMPTY: Nothing planned for this day yet.
trips.CONFIRM_REMOVE_OUTFIT: Take this outfit off the trip? It stays saved.
trips.ALREADY_ON_TRIP: Already on the trip for this day
trips.PACKING_EMPTY: Add outfits and their garments show up here, with how many of each to pack.

sizes.TITLE: Sizes
sizes.HINT: Your measurements and the size you wear in each brand. Only you see them: the garment form and your wishlist show a brand's note.
sizes.BRANDS_HINT: The size you wear in a brand, and how it runs.
sizes.SIZE_OR_NOTE: Add the size you wear there, a note, or both.
sizes.BRAND_TAKEN: You have a row for this brand already: change that one.

care.LABEL: Care label
care.LABEL_HINT: What the label inside says. Materials fill in the usual care; change anything that differs.
care.REPAIRS_HINT: What was mended or altered, and when. Only you see this log.
care.REPAIR_CONFIRM_DELETE: Remove this entry from the log?

orders.TITLE: From your orders
orders.INTRO: Products from the order emails you forwarded. Add what you kept to your closet; dismiss gifts, returns and anything that isn't clothes.
orders.EMPTY: Nothing to review. Forward an order confirmation to your order address and its products show up here.
orders.FROM_ORDER: From your orders: saving adds it to your closet and takes it off the list.
orders.PAGE_UNAVAILABLE: The product page couldn't be read just now, so these are the details from your order email. Add a photo after saving.
